Constance: "In the interest of the town and proper order, I shall be plain: I am the Clerk."

Merrin: "Oh, a chill runs down my spine whenever Greta passes—mark them well, neighbors!"  [case board: #19, #20, #21]

Odette: "Word reached me from the Surveyor, who sensibly prefers to stay unnamed: they learned that not everyone living on the Square shares the same alignment."
Odette: "Miraculously, Greta and I are of one mind regarding Agnes."  [case board: #25, #26]

Greta: "You missed something, outsider: Last night, I learned that Constance, whom we hanged, was the Demon."  [case board: #74]
Hollis: "So that the record is free of ambiguity on this point: I am the Martyr."
Hollis: "On the first night, I have given my life over for Constance, should the town ever hang them."
Hollis: "While I lack a formal proof as yet, Odette's conduct strikes me as anomalous."  [case board: #75, #76, #77]
Odette: "Before you invent a grander theory: Last night, I watched the Docks: I saw Hollis pass by."
Odette: "If anyone is keeping score, I don't trust Hollis. I saw them out on the Docks last night, while I was out on my duty."  [case board: #78, #79]
Merrin: "Hear Odette well, for I too see the shadow upon Hollis!"  [case board: #80]
Bartholomew: "No sense hiding it longer. I am the Surveyor."
Bartholomew: "The night before you arrived, I learned that not everyone living on the Square shares the same alignment."  [case board: #81, #82]
Lian: "Here's what the town needs to know to narrow the list: I am the Psychologist."
Lian: "On the first night, I learned that at least one of these two statements from day 1 was a lie or misreading: Merrin's Rumormonger reading (the night before you arrived); or Greta saying they saw Odette on the Docks (the night before you arrived)."
Lian: "Last night, I learned that at least one of these two statements from day 2 was a lie or misreading: Fenwick's Dowser reading (night 2); or Odette's Night Watch reading (night 1)."
Lian: "I back Hollis's read on Odette. I saw them out in the street from my window last night."  [case board: #83, #84, #20, #23, #85, #55, #44, #86, #87]
Greta: "I don't trust Merrin an inch. Fenwick's reading on the Square found 2 evil souls in a crowd that included them."  [case board: #88]
Merrin: "Oh, a chill runs down my spine whenever Greta passes—mark them well, neighbors!"  [case board: #21]
Nisha: "My own model aligns with Odette regarding Hollis. I saw them out on the Market last night, while I was out on my duty."  [case board: #89, #90]
